patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.quoteLong: A bee stung me and within minutes I broke out in hives all over, my lips and throat feel swollen and tight, and I'm starting to wheeze. My chest feels tight — I've never reacted like this.
clinical.presentationShort: 27yo M ? minutes after bee sting, diffuse hives, lip and throat swelling, wheeze and chest tightness; HR 122, SpO2 93%.
clinical.presentationLong: 27-year-old male who developed widespread hives, swelling of his lips and throat, wheeze, and chest tightness within minutes of a bee sting. Heart rate is 122 and oxygen saturation is 93%.

diagnosis.disposition: Resus → IM epinephrine immediately, airway, O2, fluids, antihistamine/steroid adjuncts, observe for biphasic reaction.
diagnosis.why: Two systems (hives + airway) after an exposure = anaphylaxis. IM epi in the thigh, now. Everything else is secondary.
diagnosis.redFlag: Skin + airway/breathing after an exposure = anaphylaxis; epinephrine first, not antihistamines.

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: upright, hand at his throat, anxious
signs: puffy lips, hand at the throat
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character. Match the painterly STYLE of the attached reference image - its brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting and palette - but do NOT copy its cropping, camera distance or composition. FRAMING (follow exactly): a full-body WIDE SHOT, square 1:1, 3/4 front view, subject centred. The ENTIRE figure must be inside the frame from the top of the head to the soles of both feet, and the ENTIRE chair must be inside the frame including all four chair legs meeting the floor. Leave clear empty margin on all four sides - roughly 10% of the image width as space above the head and below the feet. This is NOT a close-up, NOT a bust, NOT a head-and-shoulders portrait, NOT a cropped view: the camera is pulled well back so the whole person and the whole chair sit comfortably inside the picture with room around them. Draw the COMPLETE body - head, neck, torso, both arms, both hands, lap, both legs, both feet with shoes. Nothing cropped by the edges, no missing or truncated limbs, no body part fading out or left unfinished. ANATOMY AND OBJECTS (critical): exactly one head, exactly two arms ending in exactly two hands, exactly two legs ending in two feet, five fingers on each hand. No extra, duplicated, floating or partial limbs anywhere. Anything the character touches must be plausibly held by one of those two hands. All furniture is solid and fully opaque - the chair must never look transparent or see-through, and its back, seat and legs must all be completely drawn. Subject: a white 27-year-old man in a plain, completely clean short-sleeved t-shirt, seated upright on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: sitting upright and tense, one hand at his throat, breathing hard. Expression: frightened and struggling to breathe. Clearly visible: raised blotchy red hives ON BARE SKIN ONLY - across the exposed skin of his face, neck and bare forearms - while the fabric of his t-shirt stays completely plain, clean and unmarked with NO spots, blotches or marks on the clothing whatsoever; visibly swollen puffy lips; one hand at the throat. Overall: frightened and in real respiratory difficulty. No text, no logos, no watermarks, no border.
